pages.title: knock-it-down
pages.creator: merrymaker14
pages.description:
knock-it-down puts you in charge of a demolition service with a slingshot as its main tool. Pull the ball back, aim at the job's target and release to fire. Different projectiles give you options for bringing down structures and completing each order's objective.

The game offers 120 jobs across five districts, with six projectile choices and upgrades to develop your equipment. Earn stars and scrap from completed work, then use the map to buy improvements before taking another assignment. Choose ammunition with the on-screen buttons and judge how a shot will affect the structure, aiming for a precise result as well as a successful demolition.

pages.title: Papas Burger Cook
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Papas Burger Cook puts you in a busy burger kitchen serving hungry customers. Prepare meals, discover recipes and work through different burger restaurants as you develop your cooking career. The challenge centers on turning the available recipes into food ready to serve.

Use the mouse or touch controls to take part in the kitchen activities. Keep working through the meals and restaurants to improve your chef's rank. Traveling between burger shops gives the cooking tasks a wider progression, with more recipes to learn along the way.

pages.title: Zombies Weapon Merge 4
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Zombies Weapon Merge 4 combines building weapons with fighting waves of zombies. Match identical guns to create stronger ones, improve your firepower and position the weapons to deal with the attackers. Merging and combat feed into the same survival objective.

Use the mouse or tap controls to play. Consider both the weapons you can combine and the placement of the equipment already available before facing tougher enemies. Continue aiming and shooting through the zombie waves, developing the guns as the pressure on your defenses increases.

pages.title: Survive The Night
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Survive The Night is a room-based horror game about staying alive until morning. Explore the dark rooms, collect useful objects such as keys, planks and amulets, and prepare for the monsters threatening the area. Move to safety when danger approaches, then return to the search when you can.

Drag to move and click or tap to inspect the surroundings. Choose Normal mode for more hints, fewer rooms and standard monsters, or try Horror mode for the other version of the challenge. The task connects searching for supplies with responding to the threats that appear during the night.

pages.title: Fire Ball and Water Ball: Parkour Love Balls
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description:
Fire Ball and Water Ball: Parkour Love Balls is a platform adventure with an orange fire ball and a blue water ball. Guide the orange character through the course to reach the portal, avoiding pits and traps as the water ball travels alongside you.

Move and jump with WASD or the arrow keys, or use the on-screen buttons. The levels take place across different biomes and include skins for both characters. Reaching the portal is the win condition, so concentrate on completing the route safely with your companion as you work through the parkour stages.

pages.title: Metaxis
pages.creator: The Weekend Gamedev
pages.description:
Metaxis is an isometric puzzle-platformer where remaining still is deadly. Enter a black-and-white underworld to rescue a lost soul, keep moving through dangerous levels and work out how to reach the end of each area. Traps and enemies make every pause a risk.

A short-range teleport gives you a way to cross gaps, escape danger or reposition. Move with WASD, jump with Space, teleport with E and interact with F. Use those actions together as you solve the route while staying in motion. M opens the level menu, giving you a way to return to the selection of challenges.

pages.title: Kingdom match
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Kingdom match combines match-three puzzles with decorating a castle. Make rows of objects in the same color and complete the requirements shown for each level. Progress through more puzzles to develop your castle and compete with the other players' progress.

Look at the task before choosing which colors to match, then work toward the combinations the level needs. The castle decoration gives your completed puzzles another purpose, connecting the matching challenges with the home you are building. Keep completing levels as you try to move ahead in the competition.

pages.title: Fruit Connect 3
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description:
Fruit Connect 3 is a fruit-tile matching puzzle where identical pieces need an open connection. Click or tap two matching tiles to remove them, making sure other pieces do not block the route between them. Clear every fruit from the layout to finish the board.

Look for pairs that can connect now and consider which removal will open another route. Boosters offer help when you are stuck. The game also includes daily rewards, events and fruit designs to unlock, giving you additional goals alongside clearing the boards quickly.

pages.title: Find It Out Colorful Book
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description:
Find It Out Colorful Book sends you searching for hidden objects inside illustrated pages. Choose a setting such as the beach, city or zoo, then examine the scene for the items tucked into its details. Click or tap to interact with the picture.

Work through one part of the illustration at a time and compare similar details before making a selection. Different settings provide new scenes to inspect, keeping the search tied to the page you have chosen. The main task is discovering the hidden objects within those colorful environments.

pages.title: Merge Flow
pages.creator: Puppy Yolk Studio
pages.description:
Merge Flow is a number puzzle played on a five-by-seven board. Use the plus or minus operators provided below the grid to change a square's value. Matching numbers combine into a value one higher, awarding points as you develop the board.

Click a square to apply an operator and consider which change will create a useful match. The round finishes when you have used up the operators, so each arithmetic choice needs to make the most of that limited supply. Work toward higher numbers and a better score through the combinations you create.

pages.title: Drive-in Cinema: Idle Game
pages.creator: Mad Pixel Games LTD
pages.description:
Drive-in Cinema: Idle Game puts you in charge of an outdoor movie business. Buy films, choose what to screen and serve snacks to the audience. Different movie genres and their popularity give you choices about how to attract viewers and increase the cinema's income.

Expand the parking area, open food and drink kiosks, and hire employees to help handle the work. Automation and staffing let you develop the operation as the theater grows. Missions provide further objectives alongside managing money and improving the site, connecting the films on screen with the facilities you build for the guests.

pages.title: Super Onion Boy 2
pages.creator: PowerSlash Studios
pages.description:
Super Onion Boy 2 is a retro-style platform adventure about rescuing a friend captured by a monster with psychic powers. Defeat enemies, collect coins and stars for extra lives, and discover magic-potion chests as you work toward the bosses. Transformations and special powers give the hero more ways to handle the journey.

Move with A and D or the Left and Right arrows. Z, K or Space jumps, while X or J uses an available power. Watch the route around enemies and collectibles before leaping, then use the transformations you find to continue toward the final confrontation and your friend's rescue.

pages.title: Airport Controller
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Airport Controller makes you responsible for aircraft and the services they need between flights. Guide planes to land safely, then manage refueling, repairs and passenger boarding as traffic builds. Each aircraft needs attention before it can continue its journey.

Drag a plane with the mouse to send it toward the required location. Keep track of which service each aircraft still needs while making room for the others arriving at the airport. Coordinating those tasks is the central management challenge, and P pauses the game when you need a break from the traffic.

pages.title: Racing Pinball
pages.creator: Digital Will Inc.
pages.description:
Racing Pinball is an arcade pinball game about keeping a ball in play and building a high score. Launch it onto the table, then use the flippers to send it toward bumpers, targets and ramps. Each return is another chance to keep the action going.

Watch the ball as it approaches the flippers and time the next strike to reach useful parts of the table. The longer you can maintain play, the more opportunities you have to hit scoring features and improve the result of the attempt.

pages.title: Gladiators. Merge and Fight
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Gladiators. Merge and Fight combines equipment crafting with arena combat. Start by developing the materials used for a gladiator's weapon, shield, armor and helmet. Drag materials between cells, onto equipment slots or toward another material, and use Craft to produce a level-one material when needed.

The quality of the equipment changes your hero's attributes before the battle begins. Once the gladiator is ready, enter the arena and use the Attack and Block buttons to fight. The two stages connect your material choices with the performance of the character you have prepared for combat.

pages.title: School Teacher Simulator
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description:
School Teacher Simulator puts you in a classroom to assess students' work. Choose a student to answer, check the response and decide which grade to award. Homework and tests provide further opportunities to judge the answers using your own school knowledge.

Use the mouse or touch controls to select a student and the grading buttons. The game offers marks of two or five, making each response a decision about how the student's work should be evaluated. Keep checking the questions and answers as you carry out the teacher's role across the classroom activities.

pages.title: Simon Super Rabbit
pages.creator: Tap Tap Tales
pages.description:
Simon Super Rabbit follows Simon, Gaspard, Lou and Ferdinand as they become superheroes to recover their stolen marbles. Professor Wolf and his minions have challenged them to a competition, so help the friends win the events and take back what belongs to them.

The activities include marble challenges and drawing routes through obstacles. Work through the different tasks as the story moves between Simon's friends and the Professor's team. Each success contributes to the effort to beat Wolf and recover the marbles he refuses to return.

pages.title: Robot Band - Find the Differences
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description:
Robot Band - Find the Differences asks you to compare pictures of robots playing musical instruments. Spot the details that have changed and click or tap them before the timer runs out. Each picture gives you another scene from the band to inspect.

Random selections are costly: five touches that miss the differences end the game. Compare the same part of both pictures before making a choice, looking at the robots, instruments and surrounding details. Find the remaining changes quickly while keeping those mistakes within the limit.

pages.title: Human Evolution Run
pages.creator: Sixcube
pages.description: Human Evolution Run starts your character as a skeleton. Swipe to steer through the course and choose the evolution route you want to follow. Look at the paths ahead before moving so you can keep the character headed toward your chosen development.

pages.title: Zombie Drift 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Zombie Drift 3D is a driving challenge about clearing a route to the exit. Control the car and hit the targets around the area until the exit opens, then complete the level by making your way out. The objective is clearing the scene through driving and collisions.

Tap to begin and look over what still needs to be hit before approaching the exit. Work the car around the remaining targets, keeping enough control to continue toward the next one. A successful attempt depends on opening that final route.

pages.title: Is it right
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Is it right is a color-guessing puzzle where feedback helps you work out the correct arrangement. Choose colors, check the result and use the markers to improve the next guess. Green means a correct choice, yellow identifies a color in the wrong place and red marks an incorrect one.

Keep track of what each attempt tells you instead of changing every selection at once. The combination of color and position gives you information to carry into another guess. Progress through the levels and unlock skins as you solve more of the color puzzles.

pages.title: Tower of Hell: Obby Blox
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description:
Tower of Hell: Obby Blox is a 3D parkour challenge built around climbing a tower of platforming sections. Move and jump through the course to reach its finish, judging the space between platforms while trying to avoid falling away from the route.

Use WASD to move and Space to jump. Hold the left mouse control to rotate the camera and inspect the next part of the climb. Touch controls provide another way to play. Keep looking upward through the tower's sections and choose an approach that lets you land safely before the next jump.

pages.title: Monster Hell Zombie Arena
pages.creator: Mathf Games
pages.description:
Monster Hell Zombie Arena sends you into a region transformed by a nuclear explosion. As the latest cleaner, fight zombies and other affected creatures while moving from the hospital into the plant's streets and finally the tunnels beneath the reactor. Different areas bring more threats to clear.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the mouse and fire with the left button. The right button zooms, G throws a grenade and F interacts with or picks up an item. Switch weapons with the mouse wheel or number keys as you explore, using the equipment available to handle the creatures ahead.

pages.title: Pixel Village Battle 3D.IO
pages.creator: JZJO
pages.description:
Pixel Village Battle 3D.IO is a team shooting game set in the countryside. Join the red or blue side and defeat opponents to help your team finish with more eliminations. Characters return after being defeated, keeping the fight going through repeated encounters.

Use WASD to move, the left mouse button to shoot and the right button to aim. R reloads, Space jumps and V changes the view. Keep track of the opposing team while moving through the village, and look for a position from which you can take the next shot.

pages.title: Parkour Boss
pages.creator: Vedia Games
pages.description:
Parkour Boss is a 3D platforming game about reaching the finish as quickly as possible. Run and jump through the course, then use a grappling hook to help cover the route. The hook adds another movement option, but you still need to judge the platforms and the path ahead.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, jump with Space and fire the grappling hook with the left mouse button. Each level awards up to three stars, giving you a reason to improve the time of a completed run. Learn where the hook helps you travel efficiently as you work toward better results.

pages.title: Baby Dress Up
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description:
Baby Dress Up lets you customize a baby doll and prepare an outfit for a birthday party. Choose features such as skin tone, hair, eyes and mouth, then browse the clothing to put together the baby's appearance. Diaper changing is also part of the care activities.

Use the left mouse button to change the outfit and try different costume choices. The character options let you shape the doll before dressing it, while the wardrobe provides further ways to create a party look. Combine those selections into the baby you want to bring to the celebration.

pages.title: Home Decor Memory
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Home Decor Memory is a card-matching game featuring household decorations. Reveal a card, remember the item it shows and find the card carrying the same picture. Match the entire board to complete the current level.

Use the mouse or touchpad to select cards. A decoration you reveal can help you with a later pair, even if the current choices do not match. The game contains sixteen levels, giving you a sequence of boards to clear by remembering where the home-decor items are hidden.

pages.title: Bubble Sort
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description:
Bubble Sort is a color-sorting puzzle played with balls in tubes. Move the top ball from one tube to another, organizing the contents until each color is together in its own tube. A move onto another ball is allowed only when the colors match and the destination has room.

Tap the tubes to make your selections and watch the available space before transferring a ball. Clearing a useful opening can make the next set of moves possible. You can undo individual steps with the back button or restart the level when you want to reconsider the arrangement.

pages.title: Bffs Happy Halloween Party
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description:
Bffs Happy Halloween Party follows a group of friends preparing for a celebration at the sisters' home. Help the girls choose Halloween costumes before the party begins, using the clothing options to create a look for each guest.

Click with the left mouse button to select the items you want them to wear. Compare the costume pieces as you put an outfit together, then continue styling the friends for the same Halloween occasion. The game focuses on those party preparations through dress-up choices.

pages.title: 2048 Billiards 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description:
2048 Billiards 3D turns number merging into an aiming puzzle. Choose an angle that brings a ball into another carrying the same number, combining them into a higher value. Work toward the target for the current challenge and try to create the 2048 ball.

Use the mouse or tap controls to play. Completing objectives earns gold coins that can unlock props, adding another goal alongside developing the numbered balls. Consider the target's position before making your shot so the collision creates the merge you need.

pages.title: Noob vs 1000 Freddys
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Noob vs 1000 Freddys is a shooting adventure across five maps filled with hostile FNAF characters. Explore the different worlds, find the enemies and use the available firearms to take them down. Weapons range from a pistol and shotgun to a sniper rifle and heavier guns.

Move with WASD and look around with the mouse. Left click fires, right click aims, R reloads and the mouse wheel changes weapons. Use F to collect items, G for grenades and Space to jump as you work through the maps. Searching the areas and dealing with the enemies you find form the main tasks of the adventure.

pages.title: Zen Cube 3D
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description:
Zen Cube 3D is a matching puzzle played around a three-dimensional arrangement of cubes. Rotate the structure with a swipe to find pieces carrying the same design, then select three matching cubes to clear a set. The goal is to remove all the tiles before the time limit expires.

Your selections enter a collecting bar, so watch the space remaining there before choosing another piece. Filling the bar puts the attempt at risk. Look around the other sides of the cube for a complete match, and use the available props when they help you finish a difficult group.

pages.title: Brick Out
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description:
Brick Out is a brick-breaking game where you aim a ball toward the tiles and keep it returning to a landing paddle. Break as many bricks as possible while moving the paddle underneath the ball for its next return. Weapons provide additional ways to destroy groups of bricks.

Drag the paddle with the mouse to line up the landing position, then continue sending the ball back into the field. Pay attention to the return path as well as the bricks you want to hit, keeping the ball in play while building up the destruction and score.

pages.title: BubbleQuod 2
pages.creator: Garbuz Studio
pages.description:
BubbleQuod 2 puts Sam inside a protective bubble and asks you to help him escape each level. The bubble shields him from poisonous water, so keeping it intact is part of finding the way out. Move through the scene while considering which route preserves that protection.

Use the Left, Up and Right arrows to control the hero, and press Space to switch characters. Hold and drag the mouse to inspect the whole level. Looking beyond the immediate area helps you work out how the characters and their routes can lead toward the escape.

pages.title: Laser Cannon
pages.creator: HyperCarrot
pages.description:
Laser Cannon is a shooting puzzle about eliminating every monster in a level. Aim the cannon with the mouse or touchpad and use its shots to hit enemies, cause explosions or bring objects down onto them. A solution needs to account for the monsters still left after the first impact.

Look at the arrangement before firing and consider how the objects around a target might help. A well-chosen shot can make the environment do part of the work. Continue destroying the monsters until the entire level has been cleared.

pages.title: Street Fight Match
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description:
Street Fight Match connects color matching with a fight starring Ultraman. Remove balls of the same color to make the hero strike his opponent. Keep producing matches to defeat the enemy and complete the level's target.

Use the mouse or touch controls to play, looking for the next color combination while the battle unfolds. Special props offer extra help with the puzzle. Your matching decisions drive the combat, so keep clearing colored balls to help Ultraman defeat the next opponent.

pages.title: Pumpkins Halloween
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description:
Pumpkins Halloween is a path-making puzzle with dangerous pumpkins, diamonds and bones to position. Tap the screen to fix bones in place and create a route through the scene. You need to collect three diamonds and reach the white circle to finish the objective.

Watch the pumpkins while deciding how the next bone should be placed. The route needs to account for the collectibles as well as the final circle, giving you several positions to consider before making the next connection.

pages.title: Little Princess Kitten Rescue
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description:
Little Princess Kitten Rescue follows Emma as she helps an abandoned kitten found by the road. Care for the animal's wounds and discomfort, then move on to its makeover and clothing. The game takes the kitten from rescue through treatment to a finished new look.

Use the mouse to take part in the care and styling activities. Complete the tasks around helping the kitten recover, then choose outfits for the character's new life with the princess. The sequence combines animal care with the dress-up choices that follow it.

pages.title: Time Touch
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Time Touch is a timing puzzle about destroying an enemy ball. Click or tap at the right moment to make the required hit. Watch the ball before choosing your moment, keeping the focus on when you act as you try to complete the challenge.

pages.title: ABC game
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description:
ABC game is a word-and-picture activity covering vocabulary from A to Z. Look at the word presented by the game, then choose the image that corresponds to it. Click the correct picture to give your answer.

The task connects recognizing a written word with identifying the object it names. Compare the available images before selecting one, then continue through the alphabet-based activities. The game was developed by Nau.kids and keeps the interaction focused on choosing the matching picture.

pages.title: Real Chess Online
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description:
Real Chess Online offers chess against an adjustable computer opponent or a second player. Select the difficulty for solo play, or set up a two-player game with controls for the time per move, clock increments and each player's total time.

You can switch between a 2D and 3D view during play and customize the board and pieces with different styles and colors. A player name and flag provide further personalization options. Tap the board to make moves, using the display and time settings that suit the kind of chess game you want to play.

pages.title: Super Buddy Archer
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Super Buddy Archer is a bow-and-arrow puzzle about rescuing a friend hanging from a rope. Aim a shot that cuts the rope and frees the character, using the objects in each level to help find a solution. TNT, boxes, ricochets and other hazards change the route an arrow may need to take.

Use the mouse or touch controls to play. Collect stars to unlock more levels, then work out how to rescue the next character through its different obstacle arrangement. The challenge is placing the arrow well enough to solve the scene and release your friend.

pages.title: Police Cars Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description:
Police Cars Jigsaw Puzzle offers eight police-car pictures to rebuild. Choose a difficulty with a two-by-three, three-by-four or four-by-six piece layout, then drag the parts into their correct positions to complete the image.

Use the mouse to arrange the pieces and compare both their edges and the details of the car. The different grid sizes let you change the size of the puzzle challenge while working through the picture collection. Finish placing every piece to restore the selected police-car scene.

pages.title: Animals Connect
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Animals Connect is a tile puzzle about linking identical animal pictures. Each connection can make at most two turns, so a visible matching pair still needs a suitable route between its tiles. Remove all the pairs to clear the board.

The game contains eighteen levels, each with a time limit. Completing a board before the countdown ends earns extra bonuses. Look for connections that work now and consider how removing a pair changes the routes for the remaining animals, keeping the turn limit in mind as the timer continues.

pages.title: Press the different Colored Triangle
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Press the different Colored Triangle asks you to spot the triangle whose color differs from the others. Examine the group and click or tap the odd-colored piece. The task is recognizing the color difference and selecting that triangle as the challenge continues.

pages.title: Color Balls
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description:
Color Balls is a jumping game about carrying a colored ball past obstacles. Use the on-screen jump control or the Right arrow key to leap, timing the movement so the ball clears the next hazard. Contact with an obstacle ends the attempt.

Keep the ball moving through the course while building the displayed score. Watch where the next obstacle will be when the ball lands, then prepare another jump. The challenge centers on timing those leaps and avoiding a collision as the route continues.

pages.title: ATV Quad Bike Taxi Game
pages.creator: MaxZoon
pages.description:
ATV Quad Bike Taxi Game is a quad-bike driving game with routes to complete through the city. Control the vehicle with the keyboard and follow the level's checkpoints toward the finish. The course puts steering and handling the quad at the center of each assignment.

The game includes vehicle selection and additional vehicles to buy. Work through the driving levels and consider the road surface as you travel, since mud and water can slow the vehicle. Complete the route to progress to another set of checkpoints and driving challenges.

pages.title: Jack Runner
pages.creator: pyxel and soft
pages.description:
Jack Runner is an endless running game about jumping past obstacles and keeping the attempt alive. Click to make Jack jump, judging the next hazard before it reaches him. The route continues as you try to extend the run.

An extra-life pickup appears every thirty seconds. Grab it to add another life while staying ready for the obstacle that follows. Those pickups give you a timed opportunity to strengthen your chances, but reaching them still needs to fit around the jumps required by the course.

pages.title: Sock Flow
pages.creator: IG
pages.description:
Sock Flow is a path puzzle about stretching a sock between colored endpoints. Start at one colored dot, pass through the other dots along the route and reach the second colored endpoint. Work out a path that meets the dots the puzzle requires.

Use the mouse or touch controls to guide the sock. The game offers fifty levels, each with another arrangement to connect. Look at the whole layout before starting so the route you create can reach the remaining dots on the way to its final point.

pages.title: BTS Rally Car Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
BTS Rally Car Coloring Book gives you rally-car drawings to color. Choose the colors you want and use the mouse or touch controls to bring the selected car picture to life. The activity centers on designing the appearance of the illustrated racing vehicles.

Try a coordinated body color or vary the details to create your own version of the car. The drawings provide the outlines, while your color choices determine how the finished rally-car artwork will look.

pages.title: 1010 Treasures
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
1010 Treasures is a block-placement puzzle about collecting ancient gold coins from a grid. Complete the row or column containing a coin to collect it. Take block sets from the panel on the left and drag them into the board to fill the necessary spaces.

Every set needs enough room to fit, so consider the shapes available before committing to a placement. A completed line can help reach the coin objective while changing the space left for later blocks. Continue filling the relevant rows and columns until the board's golden coins have been collected.

pages.title: Climb the Rocks
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Climb the Rocks is a timing game about grabbing the next handhold on a mountain. Wait for the right moment, reach for the next rock and continue climbing while avoiding unstable holds. The objective is to keep gaining height without relying on a rock that will not support you.

Collect diamonds to unlock additional climbing characters and try the different mountains available. Each reach needs another judgment about timing and the next hold, making the climb a sequence of small decisions as you work toward a longer ascent.

pages.title: Hunger Croc Frenzy
pages.creator: Saxxa Games
pages.description:
Hunger Croc Frenzy challenges you to feed a hungry crocodile while keeping bombs out of its mouth. Move the animal beneath suitable food and open its jaws to catch a meal. The food is welcome, but a bomb is something you need to avoid.

On a keyboard, use Left and Right to move and Space to open the mouth. Touch controls provide another way to maneuver. Watch what is approaching before making the next catch so you can keep feeding the crocodile without taking in a bomb.

pages.title: Sweet Helloween Bubble Shooter Game
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description:
Sweet Helloween Bubble Shooter Game is a Halloween-themed matching game with colored bubbles. Aim and shoot to create groups of at least three in the same color, clearing the formation to meet the current level's objective. Challenges include clearing the top and rescuing the monster character.

Watch the bubbles available before choosing where to fire. Color-ball and fire-ball power-ups offer additional ways to affect the formation when a normal match is difficult to reach. Use the aiming and matching loop to work through the level map, keeping the current rescue or clearing target in view.

pages.title: Meme Miner
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Meme Miner is a mining clicker built around collecting in-game Doge coins. Click or tap to mine and keep adding to your virtual cryptocurrency haul. The activity uses repeated mining inputs as the way to develop the coin total, with the meme theme framing the pursuit of a larger collection.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Balloons
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Bubble Shooter Balloons asks you to fire a bubble toward others of the same kind. Aim the shot, release it and build matching groups in the formation above. Keep the bubbles away from the border as you work through the available matches.

Use the mouse or touch controls to choose the direction of each shot. Watch the color you are sending and look for a reachable group that suits it. The challenge is continuing to make useful matches while preventing the formation from reaching the boundary.

pages.title: Pin the needle
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description:
Pin the needle is a timing game with a rotating wheel and a stack of needles waiting below it. Launch the needles one at a time, attaching them without hitting any of those already placed. Each successful addition changes the gaps available on the next rotation.

Press Space or the left mouse button to launch. Watch the wheel's movement before firing another needle, leaving room for its path to reach the center safely. The task is to keep placing needles without creating a collision between them.

pages.title: Stacking Challenge
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Stacking Challenge puts building blocks on hooks moving back and forth above a stack. Click or tap when the hooks are aligned with the structure to release their load. Well-placed blocks grow the stack and contribute to the score.

Each round lasts three minutes, with bonus points for setting all the blocks onto the stack. Watch the hooks' horizontal movement before choosing the release moment, accounting for where the blocks will land. Keep timing the drops as you try to finish the round with a stronger stack and score.

pages.title: Eye Doctor
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description:
Eye Doctor is a character-care game about checking children's vision. Carry out the eye examinations presented by the game and use the supplied interactions to work through each patient's checkup. The focus is on the activities around examining the characters' eyes.

Play with the mouse or touch controls. Follow the current examination task and complete its interactions before moving through the rest of the visit. The hospital setting gives those checkups a sequence of patients and eye-care activities to take part in.

pages.title: Winter Monster Trucks Race
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Winter Monster Trucks Race puts a monster truck into winter driving levels. Drive through the courses, collect coins and use the earnings to buy a better vehicle. Your goal is to complete the levels while developing the truck you use for later runs.

Use the arrow keys or touch controls to play. Watch the route ahead while pursuing the coins you can reach, keeping progress through the course in mind. The vehicle purchases connect the money collected during a drive with another truck to try on the remaining levels.

pages.title: Cartoon Coloring Book
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Cartoon Coloring Book offers twelve cartoon coloring activities. Select a drawing and add the colors you want, using the mouse or touch controls to work on the picture. The supplied outlines give you a starting point for creating your own version of the scene.

Try different combinations across the drawings, choosing how the characters and details should look. The collection keeps the activity focused on coloring, with another cartoon picture available when you want to begin a new design.

pages.title: 2020 Arch KRGT1 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
2020 Arch KRGT1 Puzzle is a jigsaw collection featuring the 2020 Arch KRGT-1 motorcycle. Choose from six pictures and rebuild the bike image by fitting its pieces together. Each picture can be played at one of four piece counts.

Start with sixteen pieces or increase the challenge to thirty-six, sixty-four or one hundred. Use the mouse to arrange the parts, comparing the motorcycle's lines and details as you decide which pieces belong together. The picture stays the same subject while the chosen size changes how much assembly it requires.

pages.title: Santa and Red Nosed Reindeer Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Santa and Red Nosed Reindeer Puzzle gives you six Christmas pictures of Santa and his red-nosed companion to assemble. Select an image, choose its puzzle size and restore the complete scene using the mouse.

The size options divide a picture into 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Compare the shapes and sections of the characters as you rebuild the illustration, using recognizable details to help place another part. The four choices let you revisit a Santa-and-reindeer scene with a different amount of puzzle work.

pages.title: Fun Lovely Christmas Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Fun Lovely Christmas Puzzle offers six festive pictures as jigsaws. Pick a Christmas image and fit its separated parts back into their positions, recreating the complete illustration. You can choose a different piece count before beginning each puzzle.

Four modes are available: the smallest uses sixteen pieces, followed by thirty-six and sixty-four, with one hundred in the largest version. Move the pieces with the mouse and study both their outlines and their image details. Work through the Christmas collection at the puzzle size you want to tackle.

pages.title: City Fire Truck Rescue
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description:
City Fire Truck Rescue puts you in the firefighter's role, driving a fire truck through the city to help civilians and tackle fires. Travel toward the emergency, position the vehicle and use water to deal with the flames. Driving and firefighting form parts of the same rescue task.

Move with WASD, use Space for the handbrake and press F to enter or leave the vehicle. Aim with the mouse and use the right button to release water onto a fire. Bring those controls together as you guide the truck to the scene and carry out the rescue work.

pages.title: Shoot the Zombie
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description:
Shoot the Zombie is a shooting puzzle where every zombie in the level must be eliminated. Aim directly at an enemy or use a rebound to reach a difficult position. Chains and suspended loads offer another option: break the support and let an object fall onto the zombies beneath it.

Play with the mouse or tap controls. Look over the scene before choosing a shot, considering the objects that can help you reach more than one target. Keep working through direct hits, ricochets and environmental interactions until no zombies remain.

pages.title: Don't Touch The Stones
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Don't Touch The Stones is an avoidance game about keeping an owl clear of stones. Click or tap to control the bird as you try to survive for as long as possible. Watch the owl's position relative to the next obstacle and time your inputs to maintain a clear route.

pages.title: Basketball Slam Dunk
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Basketball Slam Dunk is a pixel-style basketball game for one or two players. Move your character toward the ball, throw it toward the basket and compete to score against the other side. Solo play lets you face a computer-controlled opponent, while the two-player option shares the controls between two people.

Player one moves with A and D and throws with W. Player two uses the Left and Right arrows to move and Up to throw. Judge your position before releasing the ball, then get ready to move again as possession changes around the court.

pages.title: Granny Horror Village
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description:
Granny Horror Village is a first-person horror puzzle game about escaping a threatening environment. Explore your surroundings, examine what is around you and solve the challenges that stand between you and the way out. The search for an escape gives the exploration its goal.

Use WASD to move, Space to jump and Shift to run. Pay attention to the areas you can inspect as you travel, keeping the route through the village in mind while working on its puzzles. Continue resolving those obstacles as you try to make your escape.

pages.title: Mafia Driver Vice City Crime
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description:
Mafia Driver Vice City Crime puts you behind the wheel as a gangster returning from prison. Drive through an Italian city while working toward regaining your place in its criminal hierarchy. The story frames the driving as a climb back up from the bottom.

Use WASD to control the car and C to change the camera view. Navigate the city and manage your vehicle as you take part in the mafia-driving setting, with Escape available to pause the game.

pages.title: Fast Ball
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description:
Fast Ball is a ball-control game with levels to complete. Guide the balls along the course and time their jumps to get past the blocks ahead. Reaching the level's end is the objective, with the distance display showing progress along the route.

Use the mouse and the jump controls to manage the balls as you travel. Watch the obstacles before making the next leap, paying attention to each ball that needs to get through. Complete the course to move on to the next arrangement.

pages.title: My Dentist
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
My Dentist is a character-care game set around a series of dental patients. Choose tools and follow the prompts to work on the teeth shown in each scene. Activities include applying toothpaste, choosing a tooth and fitting braces, with different patients available to treat.

Use the mouse to select and control the items. The game also includes colors and stickers for decorating teeth, adding appearance choices to the dental-care activities. Finish the current patient's interactions, then continue to another character when you are ready for a different set of tasks.

pages.title: Rise Higher
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Rise Higher is an endless protection game with a balloon rising toward obstacles. Move a shield between the balloon and the objects approaching it, keeping them from making contact and popping it. Your control is over the shield that clears the way.

Use the mouse or a finger to position the protection where it is needed next. The obstacles become more challenging as the balloon climbs, asking you to keep responding to what is above it. Try to carry the balloon higher and improve the score reached on the attempt.

pages.title: EG Helix Jump
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description:
EG Helix Jump is a descending-ball game set around a three-dimensional helix tower. Guide the bouncing ball down through the tile arrangement while staying clear of the red sections. Hitting a red tile ends the attempt.

Look at the route below the ball before continuing the descent, accounting for the position of the dangerous tiles. The game uses an endless format, so the aim is to keep moving downward through the tower for as long as you can without touching a red area.

pages.title: Tetra Quest
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description:
Tetra Quest combines block placement with a quest to break black magic orbs and restore enchanted mirrors. Choose where a block shape will land, then complete full lines to clear them and destroy the orbs within the arrangement. Clearing the required orbs frees the level's mirror.

Rotate blocks to fit the space available, move them into position and use the storage button when you want to hold a piece for later. The adventure introduces additional obstacles, including shapes to fill and timed bombs. Plan placements around the orb objective while keeping useful space for the blocks still to come.

pages.title: Monster Truck Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Monster Truck Difference presents truck pictures with details that do not match. Compare the images and identify the changes, working through the scene until you have found all the differences. The monster trucks provide the subject for the visual search.

Examine corresponding parts of the pictures instead of looking at each one separately. A change may be easier to recognize when you compare the same area side by side. Keep checking the truck and the surrounding details as you look for the differences still missing.

pages.title: White Christmas Party
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description:
White Christmas Party follows Emma, Jenny and Andrea as they prepare a white-themed celebration at home. Decorate the space with a white Christmas tree and other festive details, then help the three friends choose outfits and makeup for the party.

Keep the shared white theme in mind as you move from the room decorations to the characters' looks. The game brings home styling and dress-up into the same preparations, letting you shape both the setting for the celebration and what the hosts will wear.

pages.title: Santa Ski
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description:
Santa Ski turns winter sports into a timing challenge with colored strips to tap. Press the purple and yellow sections to add to your score, and hold a tap to use the power booster. The game includes skiing, skating and snowboarding within its winter setting.

Begin with the tutorial to learn how the timing controls work. Watch the strips as you continue and choose when to tap or hold, keeping the score moving through the run. Each attempt gives you another opportunity to improve your record on the ice.

pages.title: Don't Fall
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Don't Fall is a path-building game where a ball needs a complete route beneath it. Slide the yellow cubes into the gaps so the ball can continue without dropping through a hole. The moving blocks are your way to keep its path intact.

Hold the left mouse button and swipe side to side to position the cubes. Watch the next empty section before the ball reaches it, then fill the gap in time. Collect gems during the challenge and use them to unlock more characters as you keep the ball safely on the route.

pages.title: Princess Halloween Dress
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Princess Halloween Dress is a costume-styling game about getting princesses ready for Halloween. Choose spooky clothing and put together the look you want each character to wear for the celebration. The available outfits form the basis of their Halloween appearance.

Compare the costume choices as you style the princesses, then combine the pieces into a finished look. The task centers on dressing the characters for the same seasonal occasion, with each outfit giving you another way to express the Halloween theme.

pages.title: Ice Princess Twins Birth
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Ice Princess Twins Birth follows the Ice Princess through a hospital visit and the arrival of her twins. Call the ambulance and look after the character while she waits, then continue the care activities once she reaches the hospital.

After the babies arrive, help with the game's newborn tasks, including changing diapers, weighing the twins and feeding them. The mother's care also forms part of the sequence before the family is ready to leave. Tap to carry out the interactions and work through the illustrated stages of the twins' arrival.

pages.title: Harley Quinn Hair and Makeup Studio
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Harley Quinn Hair and Makeup Studio gives Elsa, Ariel, Rapunzel and Moana a makeover inspired by Harley Quinn. The characters want to join her group, and you help create the hair and makeup looks that bring them closer to their leader's style.

Use the mouse or touch controls to work on the transformations. Consider how the hairstyle and cosmetics combine as you complete a character's appearance, then continue to the other candidates. The game uses the same Harley-inspired theme across the group while giving each princess a new look.

pages.title: Barbie with Twins
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Barbie with Twins is a dress-up game about preparing a surprise for Barbie's two daughters. Choose a dress or a superhero costume for the girls, then add accessories that work with their outfits. You are styling both twins for the occasion.

Compare the clothing choices before settling on each character's look. The game offers different directions for the outfits, from a dress to a costumed hero, letting you decide how the two daughters should appear in Barbie's surprise.

pages.title: Stickman Archer
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Stickman Archer is an archery-combat game about taking down opposing archers. Line up shots toward the other fighters and use your bow against them. The central objective is defeating those opponents, with attention focused on aiming at the next archer you need to hit.

pages.title: ChopChop
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description:
ChopChop is a one-tap slicing game about cutting objects in half. Choose the moment to chop and aim for the middle of the item, working toward a better score through accurate cuts. Food items give you different objects to try slicing.

The shop provides more items to buy as you continue. Unlocking that selection gives you another goal alongside improving the score, with each new object presenting a different shape to judge before the next tap. Keep timing the cut around the midpoint you want to hit.

pages.title: Super Racing GT : Drag Pro
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Super Racing GT : Drag Pro puts you into car races against drivers from rival clans. Win the contests, buy cars and tune your vehicles as you work through the competition. Each series includes a boss opponent to overcome before you can prove yourself against that group.

Consider how your current car is prepared before taking on another race. Vehicle purchases and tuning form the progression around the contests, giving you ways to develop the equipment you bring to a tougher rival. Keep working through the series and its boss races as you build your racing career.

pages.title: Stickman Army : The Resistance
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Stickman Army : The Resistance puts you in command of two soldiers defending a jungle position. Renegade stickmen are advancing through the region, and your team must hold its ground against them. A selection of powerful weapons gives you different ways to resist the attack.

Keep the defense focused on protecting the position as the invaders approach. The challenge is using the soldiers and their available armaments to stop the enemy's advance, keeping the team's role centered on holding the line in the jungle battle.

pages.title: Touchdown Blast
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description:
Touchdown Blast is a football-running game about getting past defenders and obstacles to score a touchdown. Guide the player through the course, choosing a clear route toward the end zone. Contact with the hazards ahead is something to avoid as you keep the run going.

Use the Left and Right arrows to move sideways and Up to dash. Watch the next stretch of the field before changing direction, then use the movement options to get past the opponents in your path. The course turns reaching a touchdown into an obstacle-avoidance challenge.

pages.title: Balloon Escape
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description:
Balloon Escape is a sliding puzzle about bringing matching balloon animals together. Drag an animal horizontally or vertically to send it along the board. When two of the same kind meet, the pair clears and an animal flies away.

Walls and other pieces affect how far a balloon can travel. Later arrangements also use direction arrows and switches that change the available routes. Consider where the moving animal will stop before sending it toward a partner, then work through the remaining pairs to help the balloons escape.

pages.title: Snow Cover Model
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description:
Snow Cover Model asks you to style a princess for a cover appearance. Act as her fashion designer and create an outfit that represents the look you want to present. Choose clothing, add accessories and find shoes that complete the combination.

Try the pieces together as one finished appearance before settling on the design. The cover assignment gives the styling a specific purpose, with the princess's clothing and finishing details forming the look that will be shown. Build a coordinated outfit for her moment on the cover.

pages.title: Princess Spa Day
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Spa Day is a decorating game about helping Princess Belle prepare her new spa. Work with her on the venue's appearance and choose the spa setup she wants for the occasion. The focus is on styling the place and its decorations as Belle gets it ready for her big event.
